headline: Digitalizing Automotive Aftermarket Requires Integrating Fragmented Chain
summary: Digitizing the automotive aftermarket requires integrating information, services, and transactions across a fragmented industry supply chain over time.
why: B2B digital platforms streamlining fragmented supply chains create efficiency gains and margin expansion opportunities in the automotive services sector.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Digital integration improves supply chain efficiency and transaction velocity.
